purpose: Claim-level deterministic gate before value comparison. It verifies that the source value is anchored and uniquely bound to the requested field, cohort and any scope axes the claim states.

conditional_axes.target: required when the review claim names a cohort or comparison
conditional_axes.population: required when the review claim states a population basis
conditional_axes.timepoint: required when the review claim states a timepoint
conditional_axes.analysis_set: required when the review claim states an analysis set
